inventory.support: Recognize imported API, static local/imported keys and inline callbacks; default Tauri application scope is recorded as framework context.
Recognize API with type/import evidence; opaque handle instances and dynamic keys stay unresolved.
Exact source-function custom rule can declare wrapper roles and a fixed bus assumption. This assumption is labeled separately from allocation identity; no generic wrapper dataflow is claimed.
Runtime port, lazy EventSource allocation and Rust debug_assertions require runtime/unsupported facts; no automatically confirmed cross-language delivery link.

rule_fields: event_key (optional fixed API key, exclusive with event_arg)
target (optional fixed wrapper qualifier, exclusive with target_arg)
configuration.selectors: module+symbol is a verified callable or constructor/type identity, never a bare method spelling. Custom rules are explicit semantic assumptions, separate from bus allocation proof.
configuration.precedence: repo per key > global > default; rule list replaces lower list; custom matching selectors override built-ins; conflicting custom selectors/IDs reject the list with lower-layer fallback.

matching.identity: Immutable module-level allocation location propagated through source imports/aliases, never class/variable/event-name equality alone. Local/factory/parameter instances remain unresolved. Explicit fixed bus IDs are labeled configuration assumptions.
matching.keys: Exact literal/static immutable aliases; dynamic/unsupported expressions remain unresolved. No wildcard expansion.
matching.handlers: Named source functions, immutable callable bindings/import aliases and inline callable arguments; unsupported handlers retain a reason and no fabricated definition.
matching.qualifiers: Exact static target/channel values; unknown or different qualifiers do not join. Conditional registration/once/removal and ordering uncertainty are visible. Fixed wrapper targets are configured assumptions; known Tauri frontend qualifiers cannot be overridden by a fixed target.

storage.source_snapshots: Bounded source snapshots are stored only while enabled, so derived event evidence is rebuilt from the same indexed bytes rather than current mixed-generation files. Existing Rust source resolution is reused with a stored-source provider.
storage.publication: Event maps by file and exact key are built before the existing single generation gate publishes the codemap/search snapshot. Requests perform bounded lookups and exact source freshness checks, not a full-workspace relation scan.
storage.invalidation: File create/edit/delete updates persisted input; dependency changes rebuild derived identities from all stored inputs; API/analysis/exclusion config changes force eligible input refresh; disabled/old/mismatched data never appears complete.

presentation.include_events: false by default for read/grep/search; applicable only to full/relations content views. source/definitions skip event lookup.
presentation.event_key: Optional exact-key search argument selects only the dedicated event map; existing query field remains required for compatibility.
presentation.separation: A separate Event relationships section; never direct calls or precise/runtime-delivery claims.

scenarios: shared KnownBus allocation with on/emit and resolvable handler
separate buses with same key; same type multiple allocations
identifier alias and reexport; shadowed/opaque/factory bindings
literal/static imported key; changed imported bus/key
dynamic key and unknown handler with explicit reasons
unrelated methods, comments and strings excluded
conditional registration, once, removal, target/channel mismatch
custom rule validation/reload/removal; test-context toggle and directory exclusion
implementation_limits: ESM JS/TS and bounded Rust source cases first; no framework catalog
No runtime delivery, registration ordering, arbitrary wrapper/factory/dataflow or external broker topology
Unsupported module aliases and cfg predicates stay unresolved
implementation_refinements: Candidate filtering by method shape still requires canonical API proof.
Imported target values join freshness dependencies.
JavaScript var uses the grammar variable_declaration function scope.
Configuration-only refresh publishes even when no event-eligible files exist.
API definition locations are separate source anchors; unresolved endpoint conditions and removal/once limits stay visible.
